title: When the connection drops during a Plus payment, the app says nothing was charged and does not check again
what: Every Google Play answer other than paid, waiting, cancelled or store-not-reachable is treated as a failed payment, including a network drop in the middle of paying. The member then reads that the payment did not go through and nothing was charged, and the app does not ask Google Play what the member now owns. If Google Play did take the money, Plus stays locked until the app is started fresh or the member taps I already paid. Buying is not switched on yet, so nobody meets this today.
expected: After an unclear answer from Google Play, the app asks Google Play again what the member owns before saying anything about money, and says it is checking rather than that nothing was charged.
how_often: rare: only when the connection drops while paying, once payments are live
fix_line: Ask Google Play again after any unclear answer and change the words to say the app is checking

title: A waiting Plus payment that Google approves while the app is closed is refunded and taken back if the app is not opened within 3 days
what: Google Play refunds any purchase the app does not confirm within 3 days. The app confirms a purchase only from the phone, either while it is open or the next time it starts fresh. A member who paid by a slow method, closed the app and does not open it for 3 days after Google approves gets the money back automatically and loses Plus without being told why. No server confirms purchases instead.
expected: Purchases are confirmed with Google by MettleUp's server as soon as Google approves them, so a closed app never lets a paid plan lapse.
who: members who pay for Plus by a slow method
fix_line: Have the server confirm each Plus purchase with Google, together with the server purchase check

items.reason: Phone payment part read whole: prices come from Google Play's own price for the monthly and yearly base plans and the for-life product, buying launches Play's sheet, purchases are confirmed with Google. Faults already found elsewhere apply here: buy buttons shown again to a paying member (FN-L5-phone-lib-core-01), purchases kept only on the phone (FN-L5-phone-screens-2-02), refunds page says members never pay (FN-L5-phone-screens-2-03, promise P-A7-legal-2-73). No trial, GST, receipt, credits or refund code in this area: the free month is counted by the app, not Play.
Test mode holds: the live switch is off, so store builds never call the payment part and QA builds use a stand-in store that says no money is taken. No fault.

Cancelled, waiting, failed and not-reachable answers are each mapped and worded. Waiting payments and cancelled or refunded plans are only noticed on a fresh start (FN-L5-phone-screens-1-02, FN-L5-phone-screens-2-01). New: an unclear answer is called failed with nothing charged (FN-L5-phone-native-01); a waiting payment approved while the app is closed can be auto-refunded by Google (FN-L5-phone-native-02). Expired or cancelled subscriptions drop out of Play's owned list, which the app reads at start.

The app's own fallback prices (149 a month, 999 a year, 2,499 for life) are shown only when Play has not answered; Play's price is shown and charged otherwise. Plus amounts never reach the panel, HQ, receipts or messages, because purchases live only on the phone (FN-L5-phone-screens-2-02). The real prices set in Play Console were not compared (not opened in this analysis-only step). Which plan the member is on is guessed when Play does not say (FN-L5-phone-screens-1-04).
